item.title: Benedictine Pro Family - Under Development by Alter Littera
item.description: I have been loving the Benedictine face since I first saw it a few months ago on pages 30-31 of McGrew’s American Metal Typefaces of the Twentieth Century. I searched once and again for information about it on the Internet, and, apart from a couple of sample images, I could only find (naturally) an old but quite revealing post on Typophile, and, of course, that wonderful manual on typography by Mergenthaler Linotype from 1923.
